chill.title: Parque da Cidade Niterói Lookout
chill.description: Watch the paragliders launch from the hilltop park in Niterói and see the sun set over Rio's whole skyline across the bay.
chill.bonus: Time how many paragliders take off before the sun goes down.

chill.title: Arpoador Sunset Applause
chill.description: Sit on the warm rock at Arpoador as the sun drops behind Dois Irmãos and join the crowd that applauds every single sunset.
chill.bonus: Start the applause yourself the moment the sun disappears.

chill.title: Jardim Botânico Palm Avenue
chill.description: Wander the 1808 botanical garden's avenue of royal palms, the orchid house and the Japanese garden while toucans call from the canopy.
chill.bonus: Find a giant Victoria water lily pad and photograph it next to your hand.

chill.title: Mureta da Urca Sunset
chill.description: Sit on the low sea wall in Urca with your feet over the water and watch the sun set behind Christ the Redeemer with half of Rio.
chill.bonus: Strike up a conversation with whoever is sitting closest to you.

chill.title: Mirante Dona Marta Viewpoint
chill.description: Drive up to the quiet lookout at eye level with Sugarloaf and Christ for the postcard view without the crowds.
chill.bonus: Sketch the skyline in five minutes, no erasing.

chill.title: Quinta da Boa Vista Picnic
chill.description: Spread a blanket on the lawns of the old imperial park in São Cristóvão, with its lake, grottoes and the rebuilt palace of the Museu Nacional.
chill.bonus: Bring only Brazilian snacks you bought from a street vendor on the way.

chill.title: Parque das Ruínas Santa Teresa
chill.description: Climb the steel walkways inside the ruined mansion of a Belle Époque arts patron for a free 360 degree view over the bay.
chill.bonus: Ride the yellow Santa Teresa tram for at least one stop on the way.

chill.title: Praia Vermelha Morning Swim
chill.description: Float in the calm, sheltered water of the little red sand beach tucked directly under Sugarloaf before the city wakes up.
chill.bonus: Swim out far enough to see the cable car pass overhead.

chill.title: Ferry to Ilha de Paquetá
chill.description: Take the slow ferry from Praça XV across Guanabara Bay to a car free island of bicycles, old mansions and sleepy beaches.
chill.bonus: Rent a bike and find the Pedra da Moreninha lookout before the return ferry.

chill.title: Parque Lage Courtyard Morning
chill.description: Have breakfast beside the pool of the 1920s mansion courtyard, with Christ the Redeemer peering down through the jungle above.
chill.bonus: Take the classic courtyard photo framed with Christ in the shot.

foodie.title: Esfihas at Rotisseria Sírio Libaneza
foodie.description: Squeeze into the noisy Largo do Machado gallery spot serving what many call the best esfiha in Rio since 1968.
foodie.bonus: Eat one of each of the four esfiha flavours and rank them.

foodie.title: Bolinhos at Bar Urca
foodie.description: Order seafood empadas and bolinhos de bacalhau from the 1939 corner bar and eat them on the sea wall across the street.
foodie.bonus: Share a bolinho with the person sitting next to you on the wall.

foodie.title: CADEG Saturday Lunch
foodie.description: Join cariocas for a Portuguese bacalhau lunch and cold beer among the flower stalls of Rio's municipal market in Benfica.
foodie.bonus: Buy a bunch of flowers from the market and give it to someone on the way home.

foodie.title: Cervantes Pernil and Pineapple Sandwich
foodie.description: Grab the legendary roast pork and pineapple sandwich at the 1955 Copacabana institution that feeds night owls until the early hours.
foodie.bonus: Order it at the counter in Portuguese without pointing.

foodie.title: Feira de São Cristóvão
foodie.description: Eat carne de sol, tapioca and baião de dois in the huge northeastern Brazil fair, then stay for forró on the stages until late.
foodie.bonus: Dance one full forró song with a stranger who offers to teach you.

foodie.title: Galeto Sat's Late Night Galeto
foodie.description: End a night out at the counter of Copacabana's heritage galeto bar for crispy grilled spring chicken with garlic sauce, served until dawn.
foodie.bonus: Try all three sauces, lemon, orange and garlic, and crown a winner.

foodie.title: Lunch on the Terrace at Aprazível
foodie.description: Eat moqueca and Amazon fish in a treehouse style garden high in Santa Teresa with the whole bay of Guanabara laid out below.
foodie.bonus: Order the one dish on the menu with an ingredient you have never heard of.

foodie.title: Cabrito at Nova Capela
foodie.description: Share the famous roast goat with broccoli rice and cod fritters at the century old Lapa tavern where the waiters have seen it all.
foodie.bonus: Ask your waiter how long he has worked there and toast to the answer.

foodie.title: Feijoada at Bar do Mineiro
foodie.description: Ride up to Santa Teresa for a Saturday feijoada and pastéis de feijão at the bohemian corner bar locals have loved since 1992.
foodie.bonus: Finish the feijoada with a caipirinha and a slice of orange, the proper carioca way.

foodie.title: Adega Pérola Petiscos
foodie.description: Point at the glass counter full of octopus, sardines and marinated peppers in this 1957 Portuguese tavern and build a feast of small plates.
foodie.bonus: Order three plates you have never tried, chosen only by pointing.

foodie.title: Churrascaria Palace Rodízio
foodie.description: Flip your card to green at the 1951 Copacabana steakhouse that invented the butterfly picanha and let the skewers keep coming.
foodie.bonus: Try one cut you have never heard of before you allow yourself any picanha.

foodie.title: Confeitaria Colombo
foodie.description: Take afternoon tea under the Belle Époque mirrors and stained glass skylight of the café that has served Rio since 1894.
foodie.bonus: Order a pastry you cannot pronounce and ask the waiter to teach you the name.

social.title: Roda de Samba at Pedra do Sal
social.description: Squeeze into the crowd around the musicians on the historic stone steps where samba was born and sing along under the stars.
social.bonus: Learn the chorus of one song and sing it back to the band.

social.title: Live Samba at Rio Scenarium
social.description: Dance samba and gafieira on three floors of antiques in Lapa's most famous music house, with live bands playing until late.
social.bonus: Accept the first dance invitation you get, no excuses.

social.title: Chopp at Bracarense
social.description: Stand on the Leblon sidewalk after the beach with an ice cold chopp and the famous shrimp and catupiry bolinhos at this 1961 boteco.
social.bonus: Order your next chopp in Portuguese and ask for it bem gelado.

social.title: Patanisca at Pavão Azul
social.description: Grab a plastic chair on the sidewalk at Copacabana's favourite boteco for cold chopp and the famous cod patanisca.
social.bonus: Invite the next table to share a round of pataniscas.

social.title: Match Day at Maracanã
social.description: Join 70,000 singing fans for Flamengo or Fluminense at the most famous football stadium on the planet.
social.bonus: Learn one terrace chant before kickoff and sing it with the fans around you.

social.title: Feira do Rio Antigo on Rua do Lavradio
social.description: Browse antiques, vinyl and street food at the monthly Saturday fair that fills Rua do Lavradio with live choro and samba.
social.bonus: Buy one vintage object under 10 USD and invent a story about who owned it.

social.title: Concert at Circo Voador
social.description: See a Brazilian band under the iconic circus tent beneath the Lapa Arches, the stage that launched a generation of Rio rock and samba.
social.bonus: Buy a ticket to an artist you have never heard of.

social.title: Samba do Trabalhador Monday Roda
social.description: Spend a Monday afternoon at Clube Renascença where Moacyr Luz leads the roda that samba musicians made their own on their day off.
social.bonus: Skip your phone for the whole first set and just listen.

social.title: Mangueira Samba School Rehearsal
social.description: Feel the bateria shake your ribs at a pre-Carnival rehearsal in the green and pink quadra of Estação Primeira de Mangueira.
social.bonus: Learn the chorus of this year's samba enredo and sing it with the community.

social.title: Samba Night at Carioca da Gema
social.description: Catch live samba in the intimate Lapa house where legends like Beth Carvalho and Zeca Pagodinho have played.
social.bonus: Get up and dance by the stage for the whole last song.

social.title: Carnival Street Bloco Cordão da Bola Preta
social.description: Put on black and white polka dots and march through Centro with hundreds of thousands of revellers in Rio's oldest Carnival street bloco.
social.bonus: Wear a full polka dot outfit and swap one accessory with a stranger.

social.title: Footvolley Pickup at Posto 9
social.description: Hang out at Ipanema's liveliest beach stretch, watch the footvolley players and get yourself into a game before sunset.
social.bonus: Ask a group to let you play one point, then buy them a round of mate.

culture.title: Instituto Moreira Salles Gávea
culture.description: See photography and music archives in a modernist house wrapped in a Burle Marx garden at the foot of the forest in Gávea.
culture.bonus: Find the Burle Marx tile mural in the garden and sit by the pool for ten quiet minutes.

culture.title: Theatro Municipal Guided Tour
culture.description: Step inside the gilded 1909 opera house on Cinelândia and see its marble staircase, mosaics and the Assyrian salon in the basement.
culture.bonus: Come back for a cheap ballet or opera ticket in the upper gallery within the month.

culture.title: Museu do Amanhã
culture.description: Explore Santiago Calatrava's white skeleton of a building on the Porto Maravilha waterfront and its immersive exhibits about the future of the planet.
culture.bonus: Walk the Boulevard Olímpico afterwards and find the giant Kobra mural.

culture.title: Christ the Redeemer at Opening Time
culture.description: Take the first cog train up Corcovado and meet the 30 m statue of Cristo Redentor before the crowds, with the whole city waking up below.
culture.bonus: Do the open arms photo, then turn around and take one of the view only, no people.

culture.title: Museu Imperial Petrópolis
culture.description: Head up into the cool mountains to Emperor Pedro II's summer palace, slide around in felt slippers and see the imperial crown jewels.
culture.bonus: Walk to the Palácio de Cristal afterwards and buy a local chocolate on the way.

culture.title: MAC Niterói
culture.description: Take the ferry across the bay to Oscar Niemeyer's flying saucer museum perched on a cliff, with the best view back at Rio.
culture.bonus: Recreate the flying saucer pose on the red ramp and take the photo from below.

culture.title: Real Gabinete Português de Leitura
culture.description: Stand in silence inside the neo-Manueline reading room stacked floor to ceiling with 350,000 books under a stained glass skylight.
culture.bonus: Find the oldest looking book on a lower shelf and photograph only its spine.

culture.title: Escadaria Selarón
culture.description: Climb the 215 steps covered in over 2,000 tiles from around the world that the artist Jorge Selarón spent two decades laying.
culture.bonus: Find a tile from your home country and take a photo with it.

8ball.title: Feira Hippie de Ipanema Wildcard
8ball.description: Go to the Sunday hippie fair in Praça General Osório with 50 reais, let a coin flip decide every turn, and come home with whatever fate picks.
8ball.bonus: Spend the whole 50 reais and give one item to the first person who compliments it.

8ball.title: SAARA Market Wildcard
8ball.description: Dive into the maze of SAARA's crowded streets in Centro and assemble a full Carnival costume in under an hour for less than 100 reais.
8ball.bonus: Wear the costume to dinner that same night.

adventure.title: Pico do Papagaio Hike
adventure.description: Take on Ilha Grande's toughest trail to the parrot shaped peak at 982 m and watch the whole bay of islands spread out below.
adventure.bonus: Start early enough to catch the sunrise from the summit, or swim at Abraão the second you get back.

adventure.title: Pico da Tijuca Summit Hike
adventure.description: Climb the carved stone steps to the highest point of Tijuca Forest at 1,022 m and look over both sides of the city at once.
adventure.bonus: Count the carved steps on the final staircase and post the number.

adventure.title: Guided Rock Climb Up Sugarloaf
adventure.description: Rope up with a certified guide on one of the classic routes up Pão de Açúcar and earn the view that everyone else buys a cable car ticket for.
adventure.bonus: Ride the cable car down and tell a stranger in the cabin how you got up.

adventure.title: Lagoa Rodrigo de Freitas Bike Loop
adventure.description: Grab a shared bike and ride the 7.5 km path around the lagoon with Corcovado above you and Dois Irmãos glowing at the far end.
adventure.bonus: Beat your first lap time on a second lap.

adventure.title: Pedra do Telégrafo Photo Hike
adventure.description: Hike up in Barra de Guaratiba to the famous ledge where a clever camera angle makes you look like you are hanging off a cliff above the sea.
adventure.bonus: Pull off the hanging photo in one take, no retakes allowed.

adventure.title: Pedra da Gávea Summit Scramble
adventure.description: Climb the giant granite head of Tijuca National Park, scramble up the Carrasqueira rock face and stand 844 m above the Atlantic with all of Rio at your feet.
adventure.bonus: Eat your summit snack sitting on the edge of the stone face and take one photo looking straight down at São Conrado.

adventure.title: Morro da Urca Trail via Pista Cláudio Coutinho
adventure.description: Walk the seaside path where marmosets hang in the trees, then climb the forest trail to the Morro da Urca lookout facing Sugarloaf.
adventure.bonus: Spot a marmoset on the path and photograph it without using zoom.

adventure.title: Grumari and Prainha Wild Beach Day
adventure.description: Head past Recreio to the protected coast where Prainha's surf and Grumari's red sand beaches have no buildings, just forest and waves.
adventure.bonus: Bodysurf one wave all the way to the sand at Prainha.

adventure.title: Morro Dois Irmãos Sunrise Hike
adventure.description: Ride a moto-taxi up through Vidigal, then hike to the twin peaks for the best sunrise view of Ipanema, Leblon and Lagoa in the whole city.
adventure.bonus: Buy a coffee from a Vidigal stall on the way down and ask the owner for their favourite spot in the favela.

adventure.title: Morro da Babilônia Trail
adventure.description: Walk up through the Chapéu Mangueira community into the reforested hill between Leme and Urca for a quiet view over Copacabana's full curve.
adventure.bonus: Ask a local on the way up for the name of the best bar in the community and go there after.

adventure.title: Lopes Mendes Beach Trail
adventure.description: Hike through the jungle of Ilha Grande from Abraão to Lopes Mendes, the powder white surf beach many call the most beautiful in Brazil.
adventure.bonus: Squeak the sand with your feet and film it as proof it really sings.

adventure.title: Tandem Hang Gliding from Pedra Bonita
adventure.description: Run off the Pedra Bonita ramp with a certified pilot and glide over the rainforest for ten minutes before landing on the sand at São Conrado.
adventure.bonus: Let go of the bar for three seconds mid-flight and shout your name over the ocean.

adventure.title: Parque Lage to Corcovado Trail
adventure.description: Hike straight up through the Atlantic forest from Parque Lage, using chains on the steep bits, and arrive under the feet of Christ the Redeemer on your own legs.
adventure.bonus: Fill your bottle at the trail stream and drink it at the top while everyone else arrives by train.

adventure.title: Castelos do Açu Trail
adventure.description: Climb into the Serra dos Órgãos above Petrópolis to the strange stone castles of Açu at over 2,000 m, with Rio's bay glittering far below.
adventure.bonus: Find the castle rock that looks most like a face and name it.

adventure.title: Costão de Itacoatiara Hike
adventure.description: Cross the bay to Niterói and climb the rope assisted Costão for a view back across the ocean to Rio's skyline and Sugarloaf.
adventure.bonus: Jump into the waves at Praia de Itacoatiara right after you come down.

adventure.title: Forte Duque de Caxias Leme Trail
adventure.description: Climb the cobbled army road through forest to the old fort on top of Morro do Leme, the best free look straight down Copacabana beach.
adventure.bonus: Find the cannon with the best view and take a photo aiming it at Copacabana.
